implementation.proposal: Immutable ExecutionProposal per contract section 3: createDomainId('prop'), schemaVersion aaa-proposal-v1, section-2 proposalHash (sha256 of canonicalizeJson over identity fields + payload), canonical deep clone deep-frozen, createdAt/expiresAt ISO with default 15 min TTL, verifyExecutionProposalHash/isExecutionProposalExpired/canonicalPayloadEquals helpers.
implementation.requestTurn: REQUIRE_APPROVAL without approvalId now calls the model, maps gateway schema_invalid to structured_output_invalid, freezes the model structured output (or {text}) into the proposal, persists proposalId/proposalHash/proposalPayload/capability/dataClassification/policyVersion/promptVersion/action/resource/tenant through approvals.request, and returns approval_required with approvalId. No tool and no outbox in this turn.
implementation.executionTurn: approvalId present: policy must still be REQUIRE_APPROVAL and the stored policyVersion unchanged (else policy_changed); loads the approval, revalidates tenant/action/resource/agent/agentVersion/capability/dataClassification; rejects missing proposal fields; canonical-compares caller approvalPayload and recomputes the section-2 hash against the stored proposalHash (payload_mismatch on mutation/adulteration); rejects expired approvals (proposal_expired); reserves with payload+proposalHash, marks EXECUTING, executes the tool with payload = record.proposalPayload only (never the model), confirms with effect_confirmed evidence + executionRef, then enqueues outbox. A confirmed effect whose outbox fails returns executed/outbox_pending instead of a false denial.
implementation.failureHandling: ToolExecutionError.certainty='no_effect' -> approvals.release (back to APPROVED) and denied with the error code; effect_started/unknown -> markUncertain and denied/effect_uncertain with no automatic retry; replay of an EXECUTED approval -> already_executed.
implementation.allowPath: ALLOW keeps model -> tool -> outbox and never marks executed on tool or outbox failure.
implementation.legacyRemoval: approvals.verifyAndConsume no longer appears anywhere in runtime.ts; the governed path reserves/confirms.
implementation.effectScopes: GovernedAgentRuntimeOptions.effectScopes?: Partial<Record<Capability,'controlled_fake'|'real_authorized'>> and realEffectAuthorizations?: readonly string[] (empty default). real_authorized without an entry, or high-risk-write with no declaration, denies real_effect_not_authorized before the executor (T-19).

limitations: No effect journal, operationKey, budget/deadline hardening or cancellation was implemented; those belong to AAA-10/AAA-11.

proposal_expired is evaluated against the approval record expiresAt (persisted from the proposal TTL); the full ExecutionProposal object is not stored in the approval record because approval-engine is out of scope.
The execution-turn hash revalidation uses the execution request agentProfile because the approval record does not persist agentProfile; a divergent profile fails closed as payload_mismatch.
Approval/capability in the execution turn are revalidated against the record when present; the approval record persists them only for proposals created by this runtime.
If approvals.confirm fails after a confirmed tool effect, the runtime marks UNCERTAIN and returns effect_confirmation_failed; completing the confirmation requires the AAA-10 journal/recovery path.
outbox failure after a confirmed effect returns outcome executed with reason outbox_pending and outboxPending=true; durable outbox retry is AAA-10/AAA-12 scope.
